lines.japanese: ん？
lines.english: Hm?

lines.japanese: あれ……ここどこだ？
lines.english: Huh...? Where am I?

lines.japanese: 耳に入ってくるのは電車の走行音。それと荒い息遣いだった。
lines.english: I could hear the sound of a train in motion, along with ragged breathing.

lines.japanese: 手や腕には、押しつけられるような人肌の感触。ああ、ここは電車の中か。しかも満員の。
lines.english: Warm bodies pressed against my hands and arms. Oh, right. I was on a train—and a packed one at that.

lines.japanese: そうだ、思いだした。俺はいま学校へ行くところだったんだ。
lines.english: Right, I remembered. I was on my way to school.

lines.japanese: それにしても混んでるな。前の女学生が苦しそうじゃないか。ちょっと体の位置をずらすか。
lines.english: Man, it was packed in here. The student in front of me looked like she could barely breathe. Maybe I should shift over a little.

lines.japanese: よいしょ。
lines.english: There we go.

lines.japanese: 「ひっ！　やっ、ややや……」
lines.english: “Eek! N-no, no...”

lines.japanese: あれ？　手がなにか柔らかいものに挟まってる？
lines.english: Huh? Was my hand trapped between something soft?

lines.japanese: なんだろう。この、指先に当たる焼きたてのパンのような触り心地のいい感触は……。
lines.english: What was this soft, wonderful feeling at my fingertips, like freshly baked bread...?

lines.japanese: そこでふと疑問を覚えた。俺はどうして目を閉じているんだろう。
lines.english: Then a question suddenly occurred to me. Why were my eyes closed?

lines.japanese: というわけで、現状を確認してみた。
lines.english: So I opened them to inspect the situation.

lines.japanese: こばとおーん！？
lines.english: Kobatooo?!

lines.japanese: 俺の自覚はないのに、なんだかとんでもないことになっていた。
lines.english: Somehow, without my even realizing it, things had gotten completely out of hand.

lines.japanese: なんで電車の中なんだ。そして何故二人きりなんだ。
lines.english: Why were we on a train? And why were we alone together?

lines.japanese: 「は、恥ずかしいよお兄ちゃん……」
lines.english: “This is embarrassing, Big Brother...”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は俺の胸の中で荒い息遣いをしていた。どうやら俺のせいらしい。
lines.english: Kobato was breathing heavily against my chest. Apparently I was the cause.

lines.japanese: くそっ、ふざけるな！　こんな嬉しい展開が待っているなら、どうしてこうなったのか、経緯を教えてくれたっていいじゃないか！
lines.english: Dammit, no fair! If I got to wake up to something this amazing, the least they could do was tell me how we got here!

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん……家に帰ってからにしよ？　ねっ？」
lines.english: “Big Brother... let’s wait until we get home. Okay?”

lines.japanese: えっ！？　もしかしてこれ、小鳩の合意の上？
lines.english: What?! Wait, was Kobato actually okay with this?

lines.japanese: そ、そうか。そうだよな、俺たち好き同士なんだもんな。いちゃついた末の行為がちょっぴりいきすぎても、仕方のないことなんだよな。
lines.english: R-right. Of course she was. We loved each other, after all. If our fooling around got a little out of hand, who could blame us?

lines.japanese: 元より、小鳩が嫌がるような真似を俺がするわけにはいかない。だが合意の上なら話は別だ。
lines.english: Obviously I could never do anything Kobato didn't want. But if she was into it, that changed everything.

lines.japanese: 奥義！　王子様モード！
lines.english: Secret technique: Prince Mode!

lines.japanese: 「なあ小鳩、どうしてこんなことになったのか……それはよく覚えてないけど、これは二人きりになれるいいチャンスじゃないか」
lines.english: “Listen, Kobato. I don’t really remember how we ended up like this... but isn’t this a wonderful chance for us to be alone together?”

lines.japanese: 「え、でもここ、電車の中だよ」
lines.english: “But we’re on a train.”

lines.japanese: 「よく見なさい、電車の中とは言え、誰も乗ってないじゃないか」
lines.english: “Look carefully. We may be on a train, but no one else is riding it.”

lines.japanese: 「これはきっと、小鳩の神のような優しさに感動した本物の神様が、俺たちがいちゃつけるように用意してくれたものなんだよ」
lines.english: “A real god must have been so moved by your own godlike kindness that he prepared this place for us to fool around in peace.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことってあるの？」
lines.english: “Could something like that really happen?”

lines.japanese: 「そう言われると自信ないけど、少なくとも現実にそうなってるからなあ」
lines.english: “Now that you ask, I’m not so sure. But at the very least, it’s happening right now.”

lines.japanese: 辺りを見回しても、隣の車両にすら誰もいない。どころか、さっきからどこを走っているのか、駅にすら着く様子がない。
lines.english: I looked around, but there was no one even in the neighboring car. More than that, the train had shown no sign of stopping at any station for some time. Where was it even going?

lines.japanese: ぐったりとした小鳩の重みを感じる中、ふと教室で見せられたエロ漫画の内容を思いだした。
lines.english: With Kobato slumped against me, I suddenly remembered an erotic manga somebody had shown me in class.

lines.japanese: ああ、ここは夢テレビか……はあ、なんか自己嫌悪……。
lines.english: Oh. This was dream television... God, I hated myself...

lines.japanese: 白くなっていく世界の隅で、誰かが俺を嗤っていた。げらげらげらと嗤っていた。
lines.english: At the edge of the world as it faded to white, someone was laughing at me. Laughing and laughing.
